caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden box with a hinged lid that is open, revealing its contents. The exterior of the box has a rich, dark brown wood grain, with metallic gold handles on the sides and two decorative metallic pulls on the front. The box sits on four small brass caster wheels. The interior of the lid is lined with a patterned material in shades of pink, yellow, and gold, featuring a series of wavy diagonal lines and circular designs. Inside the box, there are multiple glass bottles with round stoppers, arranged in three rows. The glass bottles have a blue and clear pattern with gold highlights on the necks and bases. The box is shown centered against a plain, light tan background. The artist's signature is visible in the lower right corner.
title: Wine Chest
